title: Nuclear test veterans will get full truth, says Burnham, as he confirms independent panel
description: The prime minister says a Hillsborough-style independent panel will examine the health legacy of Britain's Cold War-era atomic programme.

title: Nuclear test veterans speak to BBC about search for justice
description: Andy Burnham says veterans will get 'the full truth' as he confirmed plans for an investigation into the health legacy of Britain's Cold War-era atomic programme.

title: Anthony Zurcher: Trump's Nvidia intervention ties his political fortunes to the AI boom
description: The US president's intercession to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang has inextricably linked their fates.

title: Third of young Brits have never had sex, but many are sexting and watching porn
description: More young people in Britain have never had sex, but many are sexting and watching porn.

title: Households braced for soaring energy bills with new price cap to be announced
description: Domestic gas prices will rise significantly in January under regulator Ofgem's new price cap.

title: Thomas Markle indicted in US for possessing child sex abuse images
description: The FBI arrested Markle on 6 November after a search of a storage unit he had allegedly rented in Los Angeles uncovered the abuse material.

title: US preparing to unveil plan for new tariffs on global trading partners
description: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

title: China-linked network using AI fakes to smear Taiwan election candidates, BBC Verify finds
description: The network attacked key figures in the ruling DPP, including President Lai and mayoral candidate Shen.

title: Russia's own figures show almost 500,000 deaths in war in Ukraine
description: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.
